craft_notes: Sthāyin: wall-look (the external variant of v48's skin-wall). Rows: row 2 (gaze→made-of-that). Close: may-be (tanmaya — the whole method's promise). Rejected: 'psychokinesis' — killed: gaze cast kept; 'clay vessel' — killed: pot-and-such kept (ghaṭādi as class).

lines: In pot and such a vessel, gaze — wall left, cast well:
at that dissolving, moment gone — made-of-that may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ghatādibhājane dṛṣṭim bhittis tyaktvā vinikṣipet | tallayaṃ tatkṣaṇād gatvā tallayāt tanmayo bhavet

reads_against.argmap: Where does gaze rest? → Cast well beyond the wall, at dissolution one becomes made-of-that.
c1_essence: Vessel gaze, wall left: at dissolution, made-of-that.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta undertow (stillness with the burnt-world wonder)
